title: stemonoporus distichus
intro: Stemonoporus distichus, commonly known as Kiri ambal, is a plant species belonging to the family Stemonuraceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Stemonoporus distichus include its antimalarial, antihypertensive, and anti-inflammatory properties, which can help in managing fever, high blood pressure, and joint pain. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory effects.
